storage.notes: No built-in storage. Records to microSD (up to 256GB, not included) or to HomeBase 3 / HomeBase Mini. Not compatible with HomeBase 2 or HomeKit.

features: 360 AI tracking with pan and tilt
2K color night vision with spotlight, plus infrared mode
AI person, vehicle and pet detection
up to 45 days battery per charge (75 motion events/day)

frigate.notes: RTSP served via HomeBase 3, not the camera. Enable in eufy Security app.

home_assistant.notes: No native ONVIF; use the HomeBase RTSP stream as a Generic Camera, or the eufy-security HACS integration (P2P).

blue_iris.notes: Use the HomeBase RTSP URL as a Generic/RTSP source (no ONVIF).
